page.layout: One column of Hebrew lexicon entries, top to bottom; running head centred above the text; page number at top left; catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: בָּלַע Absorpsit, Fxsorbuit, Deglutivit. Ni-phal נִבְלַע Absorberi. Pihel בִּלַּע Ab-sorpsit, Perdidit : Pyhal, בְּלַע & Hith-pahel הִתְבַּלַּע Absorberi, Perdi.
מִבַּלְעֲדֵי בִּלְעֲדֵי Prater, Praterquam, Excepto. Vox composita ex בְּל & עַד vel עֲדֵי .
בִּלְתִּי בִּלְת Vide antè in בְּל .
בָּמָה f. Excelsum, ara excelsa idolis dicata: plur. בָּמוֹת . Irregulare בָּמוֹתֵי Deut.32.13.
בָּנָה Aedificavit, Exstruxit. Chald. Prae-ter. בְּנִיתָה Aedificavi eum. Partic. בָּנִין Aedificantes: בָּנִים Aedificatum. Infin. לִבְנוֹת , לִבְנָא , לְמִבְנֵה , Aedificare. Futur.
יִבְנֶה Aedificanto. Ithpehal, Particip. מִתְבַּנָּא Aedrficatur: Futur. יִתְבַּנֶּא Aedifica-bitur. Niphal Hebr. נִבְנָה Aedificari.
בִּנְיָנָא בִּנִין בְּנִיָּא Chald. Aedificium, Struc-tura.
מִבְנָה m. תַּבְנִית f. Structura, Similitudo, Exemplar, Forma, Figura, Typus structura.
בֵּן m. Filius : Pullus : Plur. בָּנִים . Fœm. בַּת Filia: plurale, בָּנוֹת . Item Pagi, Villæ.

page.notes: The Hebrew vocalisation and several Latin-Hebrew entries are small and partly blurred; the vowel pointing in some words (e.g. בָּנוֹת, לְמִבְנֵה, יִבְנֶה) is uncertain. The catchword בכר at the foot right is read as printed. Running head and page number are read from the top of the scan.
